tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: pin invariants verbatim pre-compaction (classify + hash-pin spans)

tools.name: pin
tools.description: write-time pinning: classify + hash-pin ONE span at write time

tools.name: audit
tools.description: diff post-compaction context against the pinned snapshot; returns the Ed25519-signed receipt (one metered event)

tools.name: reinject
tools.description: restore DEGRADED/LOST spans verbatim, or HALT on critical loss when allow=false; requires the audit's signed receipt
